service.description: Purge old LLM call logs, messages, and conversations, and strip the stored prompt and response text from call logs sooner than the rows are deleted. Messages go first so the LlmMessage FK to LlmConversation is not violated.

parameter.name: daysToKeep
parameter.description: Rows older than this are deleted.

parameter.name: contentDaysToKeep
parameter.description: Call logs older than this keep their row (counts, tokens, timing, errors) but lose requestJson and responseJson, which hold full prompts and are the bulky, sensitive part. Use 0 to skip the strip. Values above daysToKeep have no effect.
